description: This file defines a class `OpenAIContainerConfig` which provides methods to interact with OpenAI's API for container operations such as create, list, retrieve, delete, and file listing. It handles request transformations, response parsing, and some environment validation, serving as an API client/configuration wrapper for OpenAI containers within the project.

classes.name: OpenAIContainerConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for OpenAI container API with methods to build requests, parse responses, and validate environment for container management.

methods.name: Dict map_openai_params( self, container_create_optional_params: ContainerCreateOptionalRequestParams, drop_params: bool, )
methods.description: Returns a dictionary mapping container creation optional parameters, with no transformation applied.

methods.name: dict validate_environment( self, headers: dict, api_key: Optional[str] = None, )
